 "data": "
 flowchart TD
 start([\"GET /api/echo\"]) --> q1{\"Do I already have<br/>a copy?\"}

 q1 -->|\"YES — cache HIT\"| hit([\"200 OK<br/>done — no backend touched\"])
 q1 -->|\"NO — MISS\"| q2{\"Pick a backend.<br/>It failed?\"}

 q2 -->|\"no — 200\"| ok([\"200 OK\"])
 q2 -->|\"yes — error or 500\"| q3{\"Another backend<br/>to try?\"}

 q3 -->|\"yes\"| q2
 q3 -->|\"no\"| bad([\"502 / 504<br/>user sees an error\"])

 classDef good fill:#dff5dff,stroke:#0a7,stroke-width:2px
 classDef bad fill:#ffd9d9,stroke:#c00,stroke-width:2px
 class hit,ok good
 class bad bad",
 "config": null
